CollectionItemFinished: This item is marked as finished.
Confirm.Change: Do you want to save the the {name} item changes?
Confirm.CreateNewAccessToken: Do you want to create a new access token?
Confirm.CreateNewUserToken: Do you want to create a new user token? This operation will revoke all existing access tokens.
Confirm.Delete: Do you want to delete the {name} item?
Confirm.DeleteUser: Do you want to delete the user? The operation will irreversibly remove all associated data.
Confirm.ExternalRatingsRefresh: Do you want to refresh external ratings? This operation will reprocess movies and series and refresh IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, and Metacritic ratings from the configured external metadata provider. Books are not affected, because book metadata providers do not supply those ratings. That may take a while and you could reach the provider rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
Confirm.ImageRefresh: Do you want to refresh images? This operation will reprocess all collection items and refresh the missing images. That may take a while and you could reach the provider rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
Confirm.ImportCollectionData: Do you want to import this collection tracker export? This will replace your current collection data, tag management settings, Up Next, wishlist, tracking, books, and related metadata. The imported file becomes your new base state.
Confirm.ImportTagManagementConflicts: Some imported tag management entries already exist. Do you want to overwrite matching entries? Cancel keeps existing entries and imports only new ones.
Confirm.MarkAllBooksAsCompleted: Do you want to mark all books as completed? This operation will copy books from your books list into tracking as completed.
Confirm.MarkAllBooksAsUncompleted: Do you want to mark all books as uncompleted? This will clear completed status for matching books from your books list. Tracking items and progress are kept.
Confirm.MarkAllEpisodesCompleted: Do you want to mark all episodes as completed? This will mark every episode in every season as completed.
Confirm.MarkAllEpisodesUncompleted: Do you want to mark all episodes as uncompleted? This will clear the completed episode progress for this series.
Confirm.MarkAllMoviesAsCompleted: Do you want to mark all movies as completed? This operation will copy movies from the selected library into Tracking as completed.
Confirm.MarkAllMoviesAsUncompleted: Do you want to mark all movies as uncompleted? This operation will remove completed copies for movies in the selected library.
Confirm.MarkAllSeriesAsCompleted: Do you want to mark all series as completed? This operation will copy series from the selected library into Tracking and fetch season metadata for newly added series.
Confirm.MarkAllSeriesAsUncompleted: Do you want to mark all series as uncompleted? This will clear completed episode progress for matching series from the selected library. Tracking items and season metadata are kept.
Confirm.RefreshSeriesMetadata: Do you want to refresh season metadata from the configured external metadata provider? Existing manual changes will be replaced.
Confirm.RemoveAllTrackedBookData: Do you want to remove all book data? This deletes every book in Collection for My library in your account and cannot affect shared library items.
Confirm.RemoveAllTrackedMovieData: Do you want to remove all completed movie tracking data? This deletes every completed tracking movie for My library in your account and cannot affect shared library items.
Confirm.RemoveAllTrackedSeriesData: Do you want to remove all tracking series data? This deletes every Tracking series item, season metadata, and completed episode progress for My library in your account and cannot affect shared library items.
Confirm.RemoveSeriesMetadata: Do you want to remove season metadata and use the default season and episode options?
Confirm.RemoveShare: Do you want to remove this share?
Confirm.RenameTag: Do you want to rename {oldTag} to {newTag}? If {newTag} already exists, both tags will be merged and the existing {newTag} settings will be kept.
Confirm.ResetTagManagement: Do you want to reset tag management to default? This operation will remove all custom tag colors and display rules.
Confirm.RevokeAccessToken: Do you want to revoke the selected access token?
Confirm.RevokeShare: Do you want to revoke this incoming share?
Confirm.ShareSelectedToAll: Share all items in this scope? Existing individual item selections will be removed.
Confirm.ShareSelectedToNone: Stop sharing selected items in this scope? Existing individual item selections will be removed.
DragToClose: Drag down or press Enter to close

Message.AiSearch: This option uses local AI to provide search results based on the collection items content. It may take a few seconds or minutes to get the search results, but it can find relevant items even with typos or when the search query does not exactly match the item attributes.

Message.AnimatedBackground: Enable or disable animated background. This setting impacts your network usage because enabling this option will fill the background with poster images from your collection items.
Message.CollectionDataExport: Export your collection data to a JSON file. You can import it later to restore your collection.
Message.CollectionDataImport: Import a collection tracker export JSON file to replace your current collection tracker data. This overwrites the current collection, Up Next, wishlist, tracking, books, tag management, and settings in this account. Your login, access tokens, and shares are kept.
Message.CollectionItemsByIMDbIdImport: Import collection library items from a JSON, Markdown, or text file. The server extracts IMDb IDs from the file, fetches item details from the configured external metadata provider, adds them to your collection library, and skips IMDb IDs that are already in any of your lists. This does not import Up Next, wishlist, favorites, tracking metadata, or completed state.

Message.Features: Toggle collection hubs. Wishlist and Up Next accept movies, series, and books. Tracking holds movies, series, and books in progress or completed. Owned books also appear under Collection.

Message.ShareGrantChildrenCleared: View was turned off for {list} / {content}, so Add, Edit, and Delete were also turned off.
Message.ShareGrantDependency: View is the parent permission. Turning on Add, Edit, or Delete also turns on View. Turning off View turns off all three.
Message.ShareGrantViewEnabled: View was also turned on for {list} / {content} because it is required by Add, Edit, and Delete.
Message.ShareSettings: Manage collection sharing with other users. Use your share code to let others share with you, or add their share code to grant them access to your collection with specific permissions.
Message.StorageSettings: The storage settings dictate the policies for using browser storage within the application.
Message.TagManagement: On this page you can set border colors for tags. These colors will be used in the collection overview and details view to make it easier to identify items with specific tags. The tags are automatically loaded from your collection, so you can start customizing them right away! You can also choose to use the tag color for the image border in the collection overview. This can help you quickly identify items with specific tags without having to read the tag labels. The weight determines the color usage order when multiple tags are applicable.
Message.Tags: Please use spaces to separate custom tags. Example: #tag1 tag2. Movie, series, favorite, and completed states are managed separately.
Message.TrackerCleanup: Tracker cleanup affects only My library data in your account. It cannot remove or change shared library items.
Message.UserSettings: The user settings allow you to make account-related changes. This includes actions such as changing the login token or deleting the account.
